title: Bradshaw Ranch high strangeness
place_text: Bradshaw Ranch, Secret Canyon, Sedona, Arizona

tellings.quote: The notorious Bradshaw Ranch is ground zero for Sedona's high strangeness.

plain: Bradshaw Ranch, in Secret Canyon near Sedona, Arizona, is described as "ground zero for Sedona's high strangeness", the name UFO researchers give to clusters of odd and unexplained happenings. Michels says this in an episode about a book called Merging Dimensions, drawing on it as his source. The point is that this one ranch is held up as the centre of the area's strange reports.
